proof_body:
by
  intro p _ x hx
  have hp : (p : Padic p) ≠ 0 := by simpa using (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  refine ⟨x * (p : Padic p) ^ (-x.valuation), x.valuation, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_mul, Padic.norm_p_zpow, Padic.norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hx, ← zpow_add₀ (by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero)]
    simp
  · rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hp]; simp
target_source: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (x : Padic p), x ≠ 0 → ∃ (u : Padic p) (n : ℤ), ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ x = u * (p : Padic p) ^ n
